boundaries.name: tree-initialization-and-root-calculation
boundaries.obligation: Actual asset/nullifier/sent tree initial root computation, mutation semantics and authenticated openings are parameterized, not proved by the local record projection.

boundaries.name: poseidon-and-field-representation
boundaries.obligation: Native u64 inputs, field reduction and target Poseidon gates must be related; exact tuple injectivity is not unconditional hash injectivity. Pair binding is explicit and does not apply automatically to noncanonical aliasing.

boundaries.name: native-target-and-compiler-refinement
boundaries.obligation: Rust ownership/cloning, serde/debug/error derivations, field conversions, witness-write behavior and actual builder allocation require implementation refinement. NativeRepresentable is a premise, not a target nonce range gate.
